default.lede: A three-hour Bosphorus dinner cruise departing from Eminönü Pier at 21:00 — multi-course menu, full Turkish night show (whirling dervish, belly dance, folk), open-air decks across Europe and Asia. Hotel transfer available, free cancellation.

dinner.lede: A multi-course Bosphorus dinner cruise menu opening with classic Turkish meze, premium meats and fresh seafood. Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options prepared on board.

shows.eyebrow: Turkish Night Show on the Bosphorus
shows.lede: A live Turkish night show every evening — whirling dervish, belly dance, drum ensemble, Anatolian folk dances. Concert-grade stage lighting, full production, professional performers.

view.eyebrow: Bosphorus Night Cruise · Between Two Continents
view.lede: On a three-hour Bosphorus night cruise: Bosphorus Bridge, Fatih Bridge, Maiden's Tower, Dolmabahçe and Beylerbeyi Palaces, Ortaköy Mosque — the illuminated silhouettes of Europe and Asia.

party.eyebrow: Bosphorus DJ Cruise · Open-Air Dance Floor
party.lede: A Bosphorus DJ cruise on the sky deck — professional sound and lighting, open-air dance floor. Latin, Deep House, R&B, vintage, commercial — a different theme every night, the same energy.

boat.lede: A premium three-deck Bosphorus cruise vessel — enclosed dining and stage on the main deck, lounge dining upstairs, an open-air dance floor and bar on the sky deck. Departing nightly from our pier at Eminönü.

footer.desc: Istanbul's premier evening dinner cruise. Three decks, an Anatolian programme, and the Bosphorus by night — every evening, a celebration.
